[Music] My name is Swaminathan. I am from Kanyakumari Marthandam.
I come from Kadayalmootti. I am a member of the Sacred Heart Church there. After receiving the Covenant materials,
including a Tamil newspaper and a book about the Marian Covenant, my youngest daughter Vijil
brought these to my house on the 23rd or 26th (date). After receiving the book and Covenant materials,
three days later, I had rice gruel for lunch. While drinking the gruel, after dissolving the Covenant salt in it,
I drank the gruel with the Covenant salt dissolved in it.
After drinking this gruel, I noticed some changes in myself. Before consuming this Covenant salt,
there was no prayer in my house, nor did I go to church any day.
There was no devotion. This was my situation. After drinking this salt gruel, some changes happened in me.
Without telling anyone, I started praying at 4:30 in the morning and at 8:00 at night. After that...
Every Sunday and Friday I would go to church. On the first Friday of every month, I would do confession.
This was how I was living. But when I started praying morning and evening, at the end of the prayer
I would say, "Gracious Kreupasanam Mother, please prepare a chance for me to kneel before your altar and pray."
I would end my prayer like that. After about ten months, in the middle of those months,
three illnesses were healed in me without my knowing. After these three illnesses were healed,
my love and faith in God grew twice as much. As a result,
on 24/12/23 I received the Covenant. After about 20 days of receiving the Covenant,
I had a vision. I saw two orphan women bathing in the river and coming into our church yard, then going to the back road.
They were rinsing water from their clothes. They had no clothes to wear.
When I saw this, I told my life partner what I had seen.
She said, “Even if we saw two people, let’s find clothes for three people.”
So we found clothes for two, but couldn’t find for the third person.
Then I said, “We can give clothes to a poor woman who works cleaning in a government hospital.”
This happened on a Friday morning. On the tenth day, on Saturday morning at 4:30 while praying,
my prayer suddenly stopped, and I felt like someone or something was telling me, "From where you are sitting..."
“If you stretch out your hand, you can see a person. If you turn from where you are sitting, you can see a person. With someone this close, why are you wandering here and there?” it asked.
I replied, “Anyway, the prayer shouldn’t stop. Let the prayer finish.”
Then it said, “After that, you can think.” So I kept praying as usual, finishing my prayer without any disturbance.
After prayer, I told my life partner. The two of us thought about it and found that person, then we gave clothes to all three of them.
Mother showed me the cloth with her eyes. That colored cloth is what we gave them.
After that, I renewed the Covenant here and went back home.
After returning home, I had severe toothache in this area, like water was entering the tooth. But
I had to use the Covenant items and apply the Gracious Oil. That day I had no thoughts about it, and for two or three days
I kept turning unknowingly, without realizing where I was sitting or moving around.
On the third day, Sunday morning, the church bell rang at 5 o’clock. Then I told my life partner,
“You go to church. I’m not coming. Even if I come, I can’t sit. The prayer shouldn’t be disturbed.”
Saying this, I took the Gracious Oil, applied it here, held the cash-figure in my left hand, and lay down on the left side. I slept for about an hour.
When I opened my eyes and looked around, between my bed and my life partner’s bed, there was a cape three and a half or four feet long.
On the cape, there was a plastic chair, and I saw someone sitting on it. But I thought it was my life partner, so I asked,
“Why are you sitting here and not going to church? Why are you sitting here instead of church? The prayer is disturbed today. Because of you, it didn’t happen. If it was because of me, I would have come.”
But that person didn’t say anything to me. I opened my eyes fully and saw a dress. The dress was not the one my life partner gave me, but a different dress.
Then I felt that she had changed the dress given for church and was wearing another dress. I said,
“You changed the dress given for church and are sitting here. Because of this, I have a toothache. It’s not serious; it will heal when I go to the hospital.”
“Why are you sitting here instead of going to church?” I asked again, but no answer.
Then I thought, “No matter what I say to you, you won’t listen. Do whatever you want.”
Then I opened my eyes a bit more and looked at the face. When I looked at the face...
What I saw was not my wife.
It was this mother who was sitting there.
This mother was sitting there looking like that. Then I said,
“Mother, I am a sinner who makes thousands of mistakes every day. Mother, I didn’t go to church today, and you came here to see me today, didn’t you?”
What I said to the sinner was told by my wife, my life partner.
The toothache got worse. Immediately tears ran down from both eyes. Then my life partner
asked, “Is the toothache why you are crying?” She said, “It’s 8 o’clock.
Isn’t it time to get some rest?” When I looked at the watch it was 7:45. Then I said,
“I was talking to mother when you came.” She said, “Did you see mother?
That is a great blessing indeed.” After that, she brought tea. After drinking tea, I said,
“I will not go to the hospital or anywhere. I don’t know how this toothache stopped.” Similarly,
urination was very painful. When I checked what it was, the doctor said I had a wound and gave me medicine.
He said the wound would heal if I took the medicine. That’s true. The wound would heal, but then
it would come back again and again. For three years I suffered a lot. After that, I started using the Covenant items here.
I don’t know how the wound healed. It’s been just one year since I applied medicine, used the Covenant items, and the wound healed. That wound has not returned. Similarly,
on Friday, and then on the next Saturday morning at 4:30, while praying,
a cold breeze touched the back side of me near the lower back. I immediately looked at the candle.
I thought I should light the candle, but the candle wasn’t lighting; it was burning as usual. That coldness
went away. After a while, again a very strong cold breeze touched my lower back. Then I looked around and
wondered whether I should open the windows, but all windows were closed. That’s when I realized it was mother.
Then my prayer stopped. Usually I watch for witnesses and share with everyone. That day, the prayer stopped and I went to lie down. After lying down for about 10 minutes,
I had a vision. I saw a sister whom I know. She is working in a convent called Arakkuval, Nagarcoil.
Her name is Rani. She was sitting close to me. Then I...
I asked the sister when she had come. She said, “I came some time ago. Why haven’t you noticed me?”
After saying that much, I replied, “I thought deeply in my mind — this is not the sister sitting there, it’s Mother.” I didn’t understand the rest of what she said. Then I asked,
“What is the sister saying? I don’t understand anything.” She said, “What I’m saying doesn’t make sense to you. You don’t understand why you don’t know.”
I said, “I don’t understand anything.” Immediately she said, “I want your tongue.” I was confused and thought for a moment. Then I asked the sister,
“How do you want my tongue?” But my mouth was tied and shut. Then suddenly she grabbed my tongue and wiped saliva from it.
As she wiped it, I called out “Sister,” and looked back, but she was gone.
Then I thought carefully and realized I had a thyroid problem. On the third day, I got my thyroid checked, and the doctor said there was no thyroid illness at all.
So Mother had healed my thyroid problem. Similarly, my daughter — actually my son’s daughter — had health problems. She went to the hospital and got medicine,
but it wasn’t enough. I gave her salt and Gracious Oil, but that wasn’t enough either. One night while praying, I held her close,
prayed, chanted for her, and told her to go lie down. The next day at 4:30 a.m., I prayed for her again and told her to rest.
Around noon, at 12 o’clock, she came crying and said, “Grandfather, I saw Mother Mary. I saw Mother Mary and was healed. I don’t have any pain now.”
Mother said, “Grandfather, take me to Mother Mary. That’s why I was healed.”
I said, “Whoever cared for your mother, I brought them along.” Like that, Mother and Jesus helped me in many ways.
Then about charity work: near my house, whether someone is important or ordinary, a stranger or familiar, if I know they are sick, I go there and pray,
whether it is night or day. I pray for about an hour there and then come back. Likewise,
I visit patients at three government hospitals — Arumanai, Pulacheri, and Marthandam government hospitals —
distributing these newspapers to them and also bringing food. I bring food in rotation among these three hospitals.
